text: Genomic filters narrow query participants carry variants matching specific annotation values. available authorized platforms (BDC authorized, NHANES authorized) -combined phenotypic filter. Build genomic filter buildGenomicFilter(key, values). key GenomicFilterKey member (preferred) equivalent annotation string (validated — unknown string errors list valid keys). values required — character vector VariantFrequency enum members.
